title: 教育与成长词汇
goal: 辨认教育与成长词汇的语境义；选择与教育论点相符的词语搭配。

points.label: 辨认教育与成长词汇的语境义
选择与教育论点相符的词语搭配

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点与练习规格

body.p: 教育论述要区分知识、技能和经历。knowledge 通常不可数，skill 可数。experience 表示经验时不可数，表示一次具体的经历时可数。参加过一次活动，只说明有了这段经历，还不能说已经掌握了技能。

body.box: The course develops knowledge of materials. The workshop develops practical skills. The placement provides experience of working with clients.

body.p: 自主学习时也可以向教师请教。合作学习中，成员可以先有分歧，再形成共识。Independent study can include consultation. A group may reach a consensus after disagreement.

cards.title: 词汇表：自主学习
rows: Learner autonomy includes making informed study choices.
Independent study requires a workable schedule.
Self-discipline helps learners maintain a routine.
A meaningful goal can strengthen motivation.
A quiet period allows sustained concentration.
A clear learning objective specifies the intended outcome.
Comparing examples is one learning strategy.
Learners monitor progress through regular review.
Self-assessment identifies areas that need further work.
Learners reflect on the reasons for their errors.
cards.note: 自主学习也可以包括向导师请教：Independent study can include consultations with a tutor.

cards.title: 词汇表：合作学习
rows: Collaboration requires a shared understanding of the task.
Peer feedback can reveal unclear explanations.
The group accepts shared responsibility for the final report.
Each member takes responsibility for checking a section.
Members coordinate their contributions before submission.
The partners negotiate how to divide the work.
Constructive criticism identifies a problem and suggests a revision.
Mutual support helps members deal with difficulties.
The group reached a consensus on the main question.
cards.note: 共识是讨论后共同形成的意见，成员起初可以意见不同：The group reached a consensus after discussion.

cards.title: 词汇表：实践能力
rows: Students acquire knowledge of basic design principles.
Operating the instrument is a practical skill.
The placement offers experience in a working studio.
Competence involves performing a task to an appropriate standard.
A project allows learners to apply theory to a concrete problem.
The exercise helps students put knowledge into practice.
Problem solving requires evaluating possible solutions.
Practical work can develop professional judgment.
Hands-on practice complements reading about a procedure.
An internship can introduce students to workplace routines.
cards.note: 有过一段经历，还要继续练习才能形成技能：The visit was a useful experience, but further practice was needed.

cards.title: 词汇表：终身学习
rows: Adults can engage in lifelong learning through many activities.
Continuing education provides structured learning after initial schooling.
Professional development can involve learning a new method.
Workers may need to update skills as their tasks change.
Adaptability helps learners respond to unfamiliar requirements.
Retraining prepares workers for a different set of tasks.
Flexible schedules can improve access to education.
Tutors connect new concepts with prior knowledge.
A short placement can offer a learning opportunity.
cards.note: 有受教育的机会，不一定能顺利完成学业：Access to education does not guarantee successful completion.

body.box: A student can explain the principles of bridge design without yet being able to construct an accurate model. That explanation demonstrates knowledge, while measuring and joining the model’s parts require practical skills. In a supervised project, the student can put knowledge into practice and discover where an apparently clear principle becomes difficult to apply. The completed project is also a learning experience, but participation alone does not establish competence. The quality of the work remains relevant to that judgment.

body.p: knowledge 对应 explain the principles，practical skills 对应 measuring and joining。a learning experience 指一次具体的经历。只是参加项目，还证明不了 competence。

body.box: An adult joining an evening discussion course brings prior knowledge from work and daily life. Other participants may understand different aspects of the topic, so collaboration can broaden the discussion. Peer feedback gives the adult a chance to revise an explanation that others find unclear. This experience differs from memorizing additional facts: it involves negotiating meaning and responding to criticism. Lifelong learning can therefore include both extending knowledge and developing the skills needed to use it with other people.

body.p: 第二段区分了已有知识、合作的经历和表达的技能。peer feedback 来自同伴。constructive criticism 要指出可以修改的地方，笼统的称赞不算。

items.stem: A learner chooses a schedule and decides which weakness to address while consulting a tutor when necessary. Which concept is illustrated?
items.why: chooses 和 decides 说明学习者自己做决定，即 learner autonomy。必要时请教导师，仍属于自主学习。

items.stem: A partner identifies an unclear explanation and proposes a specific revision. Which term fits?
items.why: 指出问题并建议修改，对应 constructive criticism。

items.stem: A trainee can describe the safety rules but cannot yet perform the procedure smoothly. Which distinction matters?
options: Practical skill is identical to recalling rules accurately.
A lack of smooth performance means the trainee has no knowledge.
Knowledge does not automatically establish practical skill.
Recalling rules guarantees competence in every practical task.
items.why: 能 describe the safety rules 是知识，能 perform the procedure smoothly 是技能。第三项说的正是有知识不一定有技能。

items.stem: Members have drafted separate sections and must make the sections work together. Which verb completes: The team needs to ___ its contributions?
items.why: make the sections work together 就是协调，用 coordinate，即第四项。

items.stem: Choose the pair: Participants reflect ___ their errors and take responsibility ___ revising their own sections.
items.why: reflect on 与 take responsibility for 是固定搭配。

items.stem: An employee learns skills for a different role rather than simply reviewing performance in the current role. Which term fits?
items.why: 为 a different role 学习新技能，是 retraining。

items.stem: Which version uses knowledge as the usual uncountable noun?
options: The course develops a knowledge materials.
The course develops knowledges of materials.
The course develops knowledge of materials.
The course develops many knowledges about materials.
items.why: knowledge 通常不可数，不加 a，也不加 -s。knowledge of materials 指关于材料的知识。

items.stem: A learner checks personal performance against the stated objectives before choosing the next task. Which process is described?
items.why: 学习者自己对照目标检查表现，是 self-assessment。第三项 learning objective 只是检查时对照的目标。

items.stem: Which phrase describes applying concepts during a workshop?
options: connect new ideas with prior knowledge
items.why: applying concepts 是把学过的概念用到实际操作中，对应 put knowledge into practice。

items.stem: After discussing different options, members agree on one question to investigate. What have they reached?
items.why: agree on one question 说明成员达成了一致，即 a consensus。

items.stem: Choose the pair: Flexible hours improve access ___ education and help adults engage ___ lifelong learning.
items.why: access 后用 to，engage 后用 in，即第三项。

items.stem: A worker adjusts effectively when a familiar task acquires new requirements. Which quality is demonstrated?
items.why: 任务有了新要求，工人能有效调整，体现的是 adaptability。第二项 retraining 是为新岗位接受培训，不是一种能力。

items.stem: An apprentice accurately explains why a joint needs reinforcement but still needs guidance when making it. What has been demonstrated more clearly than practical skill?
items.why: explains why 说明学徒懂得原理，still needs guidance 说明还不能独立完成。体现得更清楚的是知识，即第一项。

items.stem: During group work, a classmate points out that a key term is unclear and suggests adding a definition. Which concept best describes this contribution?
items.why: 意见来自同学，是 peer feedback。它指出问题并建议加定义，所以是建设性的，即第二项。

items.stem: A graduate describes a short placement as a valuable experience but does not claim to have mastered every task. What does experience refer to here?
options: Complete competence in every required skill
A rule learned without participating in work
A particular period of direct involvement in work
A guarantee of successful future performance
items.why: a valuable experience 指一段亲身参与的经历，即第三项。毕业生没有说自己掌握了所有任务。

items.stem: An adult regularly studies unfamiliar methods after formal schooling has ended, connecting them with prior knowledge from work. Which concept best describes this continuing activity?
options: Unchanging reliance on prior knowledge from work
A single period of initial schooling
items.why: 正规教育结束后仍定期学习新方法，是 lifelong learning，即第四项。

items.stem: Use knowledge in the taught phrase: A supervised design project allows students to put ___ rather than merely repeat principles from the course handbook.
items.why: put knowledge into practice 表把知识用于实践。

items.stem: Use responsibility and its required preposition: Each group member should take ___ checking the evidence in the section that the member has agreed to prepare.
items.why: take responsibility for 后接 checking，指对检查负责。

items.stem: Use access and its required preposition: Evening courses may improve ___ education for adults whose work prevents them from attending classes during ordinary daytime hours.
items.why: access to education 表受教育机会，to 是介词。

items.stem: Use lifelong learning with the required preposition after engage: Adults can engage ___ through regular study that extends beyond their initial schooling and responds to changing interests.
items.why: engage in lifelong learning 表参与持续学习。
